SELECT s.id, s.name, s.summary, s.cover_img, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.open_time, s.avg_price, s.score, s.sold_count, s.recommend_order, s.walk_minutes, s.type FROM spot s
JOIN spot_tag st ON st.spot_id = s.id
WHERE s.status = 1 AND s.type != 2
AND s.type = #{type}
AND (s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND st.tag_id IN #{tagId} GROUP BY s.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT st.tag_id) = #{tagCount}
ORDER BY s.sold_count DESC, s.score DESC
